title: Microsoft's Document Converter Makes Your Files AI-Ready
summary: Microsoft released markitdown, a free Python tool that converts virtually any file format — Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, Excel spreadsheets, PDFs, and more — into Markdown.

title: Anthropic Published a Public Skills Library for AI Agents
summary: Anthropic opened a public GitHub repository called 'skills' — a collection of reusable capabilities that AI agents like Claude can use to perform structured tasks.

title: An Open-Source Speech Model Aims for Studio-Quality Voice Generation
summary: The OpenMOSS team released MOSS-TTS, a free family of models for generating realistic speech and sound.

title: A Web Crawler Built for AI Projects Is Trending
summary: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawler that delivers website content in a format AI tools can actually use, rather than messy raw HTML.

summary: Every Inc.

title: A Meta-Skill Designs Entire AI Agent Teams Automatically
summary: A developer published 'harness' — a meta-skill for AI coding agents that takes a domain description and generates a full team of specialized sub-agents, each with defined roles and skill sets.

title: Cursor Opens Its AI Coding Editor to Third-Party Plugins
summary: Cursor, one of the most widely used AI coding editors, published its official plugin specification on GitHub along with a set of official plugins.

title: A Fast Open-Source Document Parser From the Team Behind LlamaIndex
summary: The team behind LlamaIndex released LiteParse, a free open-source tool for converting documents into clean text that AI can actually use.

title: Project NOMAD: An Offline AI Companion That Works Without the Internet
summary: A developer published Project NOMAD, a self-contained offline computer that runs AI models locally alongside a curated library of critical knowledge — medical guides, maps, engineering references.

title: Anthropic's Claude Code Reaches GitHub Trending
summary: Claude Code — Anthropic's AI coding tool that runs in a terminal and can read your codebase, make changes, run tests, and handle git workflows — appeared on GitHub's trending list this week.

title: The Most-Starred Learn-By-Doing Programming Resource Is Back on Trending
summary: The 'build-your-own-x' GitHub repository has returned to trending.

title: A New Platform for Evaluating AI 'World Models' Focuses on Reproducibility
summary: Galilai Group published Stable Worldmodel, an open platform for building and comparing AI world models — systems that simulate how environments change over time.

title: Meta's Protein AI Models Move to CZ Biohub for Long-Term Stewardship
summary: The ESM (Evolutionary Scale Modeling) repository — Meta's family of AI models that predict protein structure and function from biological sequences — has moved to the Chan Zuckerberg Biohub on GitHub.

title: Your WiFi Router Can Now Monitor Rooms Without Any Cameras
summary: A developer published RuView, a free open-source tool that converts standard WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence — detecting people's presence, movement, and vital signs like breathing patterns, all without installing a single camera or sensor.

title: A New Open-Source Voice Model Generates Realistic Speech in Any Language
summary: OpenBMB released VoxCPM2, a free speech model built for high-fidelity multilingual voice generation, voice cloning, and long narrations with multiple speakers.

title: A Free Tool Automates Video Uploads to TikTok, YouTube, and More
summary: A developer released social-auto-upload, an open-source tool that posts videos to multiple platforms — TikTok, YouTube, Bilibili, and others — automatically from a single workflow.

title: A Free 9-Week Data Engineering Course Is Available to Anyone Right Now
summary: DataTalksClub published a complete, self-paced course on building production-ready data pipelines — the infrastructure behind dashboards, reports, and analytics systems.

title: A Step-by-Step Guide to Building Your Own Language Model Is Trending
summary: A new GitHub project walks through the full process of training a language model from scratch — from sourcing data to generating text — in a deliberately plain, accessible way.

title: VoxCPM2: What 'Tokenizer-Free' Actually Means for Voice AI
summary: The OpenBMB team released VoxCPM2, a speech synthesis model that removes the tokenizer — the step where most voice AI systems convert audio into discrete chunks before processing.

title: A New Memory Engine Promises to Give Every AI App Reliable, Instant Recall
summary: Supermemory — billed as 'the Memory API for the AI era' — is trending on GitHub.

title: Hermes AI Agent Gets a Web Interface You Can Use From Your Phone
summary: Hermes WebUI is a new open-source project that gives the Hermes AI agent a proper web interface, accessible from any browser including your phone.

title: A Web Scraper That Fixes Itself When Sites Change Their Layout
summary: Scrapling is a new Python library for pulling data from websites that adapts automatically when a site redesigns — something traditional scrapers can't do.

title: Pi AI Agent Framework Gets Parallel Task Delegation
summary: Previously covered on 2026-05-25: Pi is an open-source AI agent toolkit with a CLI, web UI, and multi-provider support.

title: How Adaptive Web Scraping Works — and Why It Matters Beyond Developers
summary: Scrapling uses AI-backed element matching to locate data on web pages by meaning rather than by rigid CSS selectors or XPath rules.

title: A Multi-Agent AI System for Financial Trading Is Trending on GitHub
summary: TauricResearch published TradingAgents, an open-source framework that deploys multiple AI agents simultaneously — one tracking price charts, another reading financial news, another evaluating risk — and coordinates them to drive trading decisions.

title: A New Design Language Teaches AI Tools to Think Like a Designer
summary: Developer pbakaus released impeccable, a design language specification you drop into any AI coding tool to give it a stronger sense of visual style.

title: Godot, the Free Game Engine, Is Surging in Popularity Again
summary: Godot, a fully open-source 2D and 3D game engine, is back on GitHub Trending.

title: A New AI Terminal Agent Adds Browser Control and Parallel Subagents
summary: Developer can1357 published oh-my-pi, an AI coding agent for the terminal that goes beyond editing code — it can control a browser, read live documentation via language server protocol, and spin up subagents to run tasks in parallel.

title: A Complete Machine Learning for Trading Course Is Trending on GitHub
summary: Stefan Jansen's open repository for his book Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading (2nd edition) is trending.

title: fff: The Fastest File Search Toolkit Built for AI Agents
summary: Developer dmtrKovalenko released fff, a file search toolkit designed specifically for AI agents, Neovim, and native code.

title: A New Tool Cuts AI Token Costs by Up to 95%
summary: An open-source project called Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and other content before they reach an AI model — reducing the token count by 60–95% while preserving the information the AI needs to answer correctly.

title: Talk to Any AI Model With Just Your Voice — No Typing, No Cloud
summary: Open-LLM-VTuber is a free, locally-run app that gives you hands-free voice conversations with any AI model, including the ability to interrupt the AI mid-sentence — the way you would in a real conversation.

title: A Free Course Teaches You to Build AI Search Systems That Actually Work in Production
summary: A new GitHub course covers 'agentic RAG' — the technique behind AI tools that search, retrieve, and reason over large document collections, rather than just answering from memory.

title: A Visual Investigation Tool for Analysts and Researchers Is Gaining Traction
summary: Flowsint is an open-source platform that maps relationships between people, organizations, and events on an interactive visual graph — the kind of view used to untangle complex fraud cases, competitive research, or due diligence.

title: A New System Adds Memory, Security, and Research Skills to AI Coding Agents
summary: ECC (agent harness performance optimization system) is an open-source framework that extends AI coding agents — including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Opencode — with persistent memory across sessions, security checks, instinct-driven decision-making, and a research-first mode that looks for existing solutions before generating new code.

title: Powerful AI Models Now Run on Everyday Hardware
summary: AirLLM, a free Python library by developer lyogavin, lets you run 70-billion-parameter AI models on a single consumer GPU with just 4GB of memory — by loading one layer of the model at a time rather than all at once.

title: NousResearch Releases an AI Agent Designed to Grow With You
summary: NousResearch — a team known for producing well-regarded open-source AI models — released Hermes Agent on GitHub, positioning it as a personal AI agent that adapts over time rather than starting fresh with every session.

title: A New Open-Source Tool Makes PDFs Readable by AI Systems
summary: OpenDataLoader PDF is a free tool that converts PDF files into clean, structured text that AI tools can actually process, including automating accessibility for scanned documents.

title: A Personal AI Trading Agent Is Trending on GitHub
summary: HKUDS (a Hong Kong University data science team) released Vibe-Trading, an open-source personal AI trading agent.

title: Trivy: The Security Scanner That Checks Your Entire Infrastructure at Once
summary: Aqua Security's Trivy is trending again on GitHub.

title: How AirLLM Fits a 70B Model in 4GB of Memory
summary: AirLLM achieves its memory reduction by loading a neural network one layer at a time from disk, running that layer's computation on the GPU, then discarding it before loading the next.

title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Its Platform for Building Physical AI
summary: NVIDIA published Cosmos, a free open platform containing world models, datasets, and tools for building AI that operates in the physical world — robots, self-driving vehicles, and smart infrastructure.

title: A Free Self-Hosted Alternative to Google's NotebookLM Is Now Available
summary: Open-Notebook replicates what Google NotebookLM does — letting you chat with your own documents and generate audio overviews — but runs entirely on your own hardware with no data sent to Google.

title: GitHub Releases an Official SDK for Embedding Copilot Into Any App
summary: GitHub published a multi-platform SDK that lets developers integrate Copilot Agent — its AI coding assistant — directly into third-party tools and services.

title: A Powerful Free OCR Tool Now Feeds Documents Directly Into AI
summary: PaddleOCR converts PDFs, scanned pages, and images into structured text that AI systems can process — supporting over 100 languages.

title: GitHub Releases a Toolkit for Writing Better Specs Before You Build
summary: GitHub published spec-kit to help teams practice Spec-Driven Development — the approach of writing a clear specification before any code is written.

title: A New AI Research Skill Searches Six Platforms in Parallel
summary: Developer mvanhorn published last30days-skill, a reusable skill for AI agent frameworks that takes any topic, searches Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, Polymarket, and the general web simultaneously, then synthesizes results into a single grounded summary with contradictions flagged across sources.
